about.heading: Aurentis Lifesciences LLP
about.description: Based in South Delhi, Aurentis Lifesciences LLP is a trusted pharmaceutical partner committed to quality, safety, and accessibility. We specialise in nutraceuticals and therapeutic care across cardiovascular, orthopaedic, diabetic, dermatology, and neurology segments — bringing science-backed formulations to patients and healthcare professionals nationwide.
